rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"What makes this company truly unique is that they care about me not only as an employee, but as a person. Seeing my manager cry with me because she felt my pain, and seeing my Director of Sales genuinely ask how I'm feeling and how life is going, are the kinds of things that make me feel at home and part of a family, not just another employee. I don't feel like I have bosses. I have leaders who inspire me and make me want to make them proud to work with me, just as proud as I am to work with them."

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"I love that Lennar makes work a fun place to work. I truly enjoy my role and responsibilities here, I feel like I make a difference and contribution to home ownership for buyers. The people that work here become family and they look after you like family. I love that they are understanding about your family life if things come up, especially with young children who can get sick often from school. I am very happy at Lennar and look forward to many more years here!"

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The energy surrounding my team is incredible. I come to work excited to talk with my coworkers and learn more about their skillsets. I always feel welcome to contribute and learn especially as someone new in my career. That level of human connection is so important in technology, and Lennar does it so well. In hard parts of life, my manager always tells me that if I need anything at all, to contact him, and I am just so grateful and honored to be part of such a place where I know I am supported. I love Lennar!"

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The culture at Lennar, for a company so large, does uniquely feel intimate. The divisions seem to be able to take Lennar's greater vision for the company and adapt it at a more local level to fit the needs of that particular area. Hearing from the executive leadership from this company, whether it be from emails/videos/ops meetings/travelling to come say thank you truly sets this company apart. It makes me feel proud to do what I do, and it makes me excited and eager for my personal potential."

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Our workplace is known for its outstanding camaraderie, which is deeply rooted in our culture. A key factor in fostering this strong sense of unity is our emphasis on team-building activities and events. For example, arranging outings like going to a baseball game or having lunch by the waterfront not only gives us a break from work but also strengthens our shared values and enhances our feeling of belonging to our cultural community."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Construction
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"This organization offers a distinctive workplace environment for several compelling reasons. Firstly, its commitment to fostering innovation and creativity is unparalleled. Employees are encouraged to think outside the box, leading to groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Additionally, the company's emphasis on diversity and inclusion creates a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere where individuals from various backgrounds can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives. This fosters a sense of belonging and collaboration among team members. Furthermore, the organization prioritizes employee development and growth, offering ample opportunities for learning and advancement."

Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: The home construction and real estate company's name is derived from a combination of the first names of the two company's founders, Leonard Miller and Arnold Rosen. Home building is soaring across the country, and Lennar's stock gained nearly 40% in the first four months of 2021.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Homebuilder Lennar operates in more than 77 real estate markets in 21 states.
